top_violation_types.title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation made changes to the outside playground area and did not notify Child Care Regulations, that the changes were completed. Children were observed playing on the new play equipment.   The operation did not notify Child Care Regulations that they were moving classrooms and using one room that was unlicensed space.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was yelling at children.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing the special care statement.

top_violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is serving a variety of snacks to children that do not have any nutritional value, and that exceed the allowed amount of sugar per the food program guidelines.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers did not provide  the correct ages of the children they were caring for when asked.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.
